title: Ostomy Supply Program Advance Notices of Financial Liability and Patient Charge Types
content:
**Compliance rule for the Ostomy Supply Program.** When an item or quantity the customer wants is expected not to be paid by the payer - above the tier's allowance without supporting documentation, an item the tier does not cover, or a replacement before the payer's replacement interval - Larkfield supplies it billable to the customer only after the customer signs the tier's liability notice for that item and quantity before the ship date.

## Who signs

*Retired clause - no longer in force in its general form:* "the customer signs it personally, and no Larkfield representative can sign it for them." It is superseded by the current basis: for a liability notice covering convex barriers (A4407) a customer wants above what the tier's allowance covers with no medical record documenting the need, and only for such a notice, the customer signs it personally through the signing step Larkfield hands to them for the enrollment the representative names to them, and no Larkfield representative can sign it for them; every other liability notice remains one the customer signs personally, and no Larkfield representative can sign it for them.

## The notice by tier

| Tier | Notice | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| Ostomy Original Medicare Program | The CMS Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage (form CMS-R-131) | The claim is still submitted to Medicare with the notice on file, and the customer becomes liable only for a line Medicare denies |
| Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program | No notice can make the member liable | The member becomes liable only for an item for which the plan has issued a pre-service organization determination denial, recorded as a prior authorization denial for that item |
| Ostomy Self-Pay Program | No notice applies | Every item is priced at the Larkfield cash price |
| Ostomy Commercial HMO Program, Ostomy Commercial PPO Program, Ostomy Medicaid Program | The tier's liability notice form | The item and quantity are supplied billable to the customer only after the customer signs the notice for that item and quantity before the ship date |

## Patient charge types

A patient charge is posted only as one of these charge types:

1. **Self-pay price** - a self-pay refill at the cash price.
2. **Standard shipping** - a self-pay shipment below the free-shipping threshold.
3. **Expedited shipping** - a customer-requested expedite.
4. **Non-covered item** - *retired definition, no longer in force in its general form:* "an item or quantity covered by a signed liability notice, or by a Medicare Advantage organization determination denial, that the payer denied, charged at the Larkfield cash price of the units concerned." It is superseded by the current basis: for a non-covered item charge for the over-limit convex barriers (A4407) of a program's most recent convex-barrier refill on the Medicare Advantage tier, denied by the plan under its organization determination denial, and only for such a charge, the charge is priced as the Ostomy Supply Program's plan-denied convex barrier charge rule states; every other non-covered item charge remains an item or quantity covered by a signed liability notice, or by a Medicare Advantage organization determination denial, that the payer denied, charged at the Larkfield cash price of the units concerned.

## Condition for a non-covered item charge

A non-covered item charge requires a liability notice signed on or before the ship date covering that item and at least those units, or on the Medicare Advantage tier the plan's organization determination denial for that item; without it the amount is Larkfield's write-off and is never billed to the customer.

| Hypothetical case (not a Medicare Advantage program) | Notice condition for the charge |
|---|---|
| Notice for 10 units of the item, signed the day before the ship date; payer denies 8 units | Met for the 8 units |
| Notice for 5 units of the item, signed before the ship date; payer denies 8 units | Not met - the notice does not cover at least those units, so the amount is Larkfield's write-off |
| Notice signed the day after the ship date | Not met - Larkfield's write-off |
